_definitions.universe_U: users with >=1 TRAIN-eligible example under support>=5 (split==TRAIN, has_observed_target, target_ts<TRAIN_END, target_class>=0); identical definition to g0/data_census/scripts/pass2_census.py's elig_s5_row / CLIENT_CENSUS.json s5.users_with_ge1_example, recomputed here independently.
_definitions.selection_key: int.from_bytes(sha256(b'PPSI_V4_POPULATION_20260926' + b'|' + user_id.encode('utf-8')).digest()[:8], 'big'); cohort(N) = the N users of U with the smallest key.
_definitions.rankable_vs_oov: on a VALIDATION(union) eval_mask=true row, rankable means target_class>=0 (target in the support>=5 catalogue); oov means target_oov=true (observed target outside the catalogue). These two are exhaustive and mutually exclusive over eval_mask=true rows.
_definitions.cohort_train_positive: a TRAIN row with has_observed_target, target_ts<TRAIN_END and target_class>=0 (an eligible example, per CLIENT_CENSUS.json), counted by its target_class, restricted to the cohort's users.

validation_union_label_coverage_support_.note: cohort universe = support>=5 TRAIN-eligible users only, so every cohort member is warm by construction; 'the cohort's own warm VALIDATION rows' is therefore ALL of the cohort's VALIDATION(union) eval_mask=true rows -- there is no cold subset to exclude within a cohort.
